t: Compact, push-wire inline splicing connectors for extending wires in junction boxes or repairing damaged cables. Suitable for conductor cross sections ranging from 0.75 to 4 mm². Ideal solution for connecting wires in tight spaces. Features spring technology and compatible heat shrink tubing. No special tools required.
b: Suitable for Solid 0.75 to 4 mm² & Stranded from 1.5 to 4mm² Cables
